name: The Star, the Hand and the Heart

meta.wiki: The Star, the Hand and the Heart (Alliance)

summary: Gerrig Bonegrip in Ironforge has a spare copy of Yagyin's Digest and will part with it for three items of power. Gerrig will not speak their names aloud, and writes them down in a note instead.

sections.title: An Exchange Behind Closed Lips
sections.body: Gerrig hears you ask for Yagyin's Digest and wonders whether you are starting a new chapter of their order somewhere, then decides it is not Gerrig's place to ask. Gerrig has an extra copy and believes those of the order must aid each other. In return, three items of power must be brought. Their names stay unspoken, since someone may be listening, and Gerrig writes them down.

sections.title: The Three Items
sections.body: The note names the Star of Xil'yeh, the Hand of Dagun and the Legacy Heart. They are what Gerrig wants before handing over the digest.

sections.title: Gerrig's Verdict
sections.body: Once the relics are in hand, Gerrig calls you resourceful and believes that, should founding a new chapter of the order truly be your charge, you will run it well.

faq.q: Who asks for the three items?
aliases: who starts the star the hand and the heart
faq.answer: Gerrig Bonegrip in Ironforge, who has an extra copy of Yagyin's Digest to give in return.

faq.q: What three items does Gerrig Bonegrip want?
faq.answer: Gerrig Bonegrip's note asks for three things: the Star of Xil'yeh, the Hand of Dagun and the Legacy Heart.

faq.q: Why does Gerrig write the items down instead of saying them?
faq.answer: Gerrig will not speak their names because someone may be listening.

faq.q: What came before this in the chain?
faq.answer: It follows To Ironforge for Yagyin's Digest, where Theldurin the Lost sent you to Gerrig.
